description: This Java class represents the domain entity 'HookConfiguration' used within the Apache Fineract project. It models the configuration details for hooks, including relationships to hook objects and configuration fields such as type, name, and value. The class uses JPA annotations for ORM mapping and Lombok annotations to generate boilerplate code.

classes.name: HookConfiguration
classes.description: Entity class for hook configuration, extending a custom persistable base class with fields for hook, field type, name, and value.

methods.name: createNewWithoutHook
methods.description: Static factory method to create a new HookConfiguration instance without associating it with a Hook object.

methods.name: createNew
methods.description: Static factory method to create a new HookConfiguration instance and associate it with a specific Hook.
